```javascript
let counter = 0;
const tickets = [];

export async function listTools() {
  return [
    {
      name: 'ticket_create',
      description: 'Create a support ticket.',
      inputSchema: {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {
          title: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          description: { type: 'string', minLength: 1 },
          priority: { type: 'string', enum: ['low', 'normal', 'high'], default: 'normal' }
        },
        required: ['title', 'description'],
        additionalProperties: false
      }
    }
  ];
}

export async function callTool(name, args) {
  if (name !== 'ticket_create') {
    throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);
  }
  
  // Validate args
  if (!args || typeof args !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Invalid arguments');
  }
  
  if (typeof args.title !== 'string' || args.title.trim().length === 0) {
    throw new Error('title must be a non-empty string');
  }
  if (typeof args.description !== 'string' || args.description.trim().length === 0) {
    throw new Error('description must be a non-empty string');
  }
  
  const priority = args.priority ?? 'normal';
  if (!['low', 'normal', 'high'].includes(priority)) {
    throw new Error('priority must be low, normal, or high');
  }
  
  // Validate no extra fields (additionalProperties is enforced in inputSchema, but we should also check)
  const allowedKeys = new Set(['title', 'description', 'priority']);
  for (const key of Object.keys(args)) {
    if (!allowedKeys.has(key)) {
      throw new Error(`Unknown field: ${key}`);
    }
  }
  
  counter += 1;
  const id = `t${counter}`;
  const ticket = { id, title: args.title.trim(), description: args.description.trim(), priority };
  tickets.push(ticket);
  
  return {
    content: [{ type: 'text', text: `Ticket ${id} created with priority ${priority}.` }]
  };
}
```
